import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Group the data by habitat and calculate the sum of n.gard for each habitat
habitat_gardening_counts = df.groupby('habitat')['n.gard'].sum().reset_index()

# Display the counts
habitat_gardening_counts

# Perform a chi-squared test to determine if the distribution of n.gard is significantly different across habitats
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(df['habitat'], df['n.gard'] > 0)
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
chi2, p

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Load the dataset with proper delimiter and column names
df = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t', header=None, names=['n.gard', 'n.unint', 'n.agfo', 'n.total', 'habitat', 'elevation', 'cropland.1956.50m', 'urban.1956.50m', 'cropland.1993.50m', 'urban.1993.50m', 'cropland.2009.50m', 'urban.2009.50m', 'cropland.1956.500m', 'urban.1956.500m', 'cropland.1993.500m', 'urban.1993.500m', 'cropland.2009.500m', 'urban.2009.500m', 'cropland.1956.1000m', 'urban.1956.1000m', 'cropland.1993.1000m', 'urban.1993.1000m', 'cropland.2009.1000m', 'urban.2009.1000m', 'progressive.1956.2009.50m', 'regressive.1956.2009.50m', 'no.changes.1956.2009.50m', 'progressive.1993.2009.50m', 'regressive.1993.2009.50m', 'no.changes.1993.2009.50m', 'distance.stream', 'distance.road', 'longitude', 'latitude', 'annual.temperature', 'annual.rainfall', 'annual.radiation'])

# Convert the 'n.gard' column to numeric values
df['n.gard'] = pd.to_numeric(df['n.gard'], errors='coerce')

# Group the data by habitat and calculate the sum of n.gard for each habitat
habitat_gardening_counts = df.groupby('habitat')['n.gard'].sum().reset_index()

# Display the counts
habitat_gardening_counts

# Perform a chi-squared test to determine if the distribution of n.gard is significantly different across habitats
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(df['habitat'], df['n.gard'] > 0)
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
chi2, p
